title: Step 3b - Optimizing K-means Clustering: WCSS and Elbow Method Implementation

cues.en: Instructor: So the first parameters obviously is going to be, well, that number of clusters we want to identify.
cues.zh: 講師：第一個參數顯然就是我們想辨識的群組數量。

cues.en: And that name of the parameter is "n_clusters" which stands for exactly number of clusters.
cues.zh: 參數名稱是 n_clusters，意思正是群組數量。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And this should be equal to what?
cues.zh: 它應該等於什麼？

cues.en: Well, if you understood the way this "for" loop works, of course the number of cluster here is "i", which starts at one, then will be equal to two,
cues.zh: 如果你了解這個 for 迴圈的運作方式，就知道群組數量當然是 i；它從 1 開始，接著等於 2，

cues.en: then three up to 10, which are the different numbers of clusters we want to experiment in order to plot that elbow method graph.
cues.zh: 再來是 3，一直到 10，也就是我們要嘗試的各個群組數量，用來畫手肘法圖表。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So, numbers of clusters equal "i".
cues.zh: 所以 n_clusters 等於 i。

cues.en: And then we would like to do something to avoid the random initialization trap which was explained by Karol in the intuition lectures.
cues.zh: 接著要做些設定，避免 Kirill 在概念課解釋的隨機初始化陷阱。

cues.en: And the way to avoid it is to initialize the K-means algorithm with a particular method.
cues.zh: 避免的方法是用特定方式初始化 K-means 演算法。

cues.en: And that method is called "K-means++".
cues.zh: 這個方法叫做 K-means++。

cues.en: So, it's basically an advanced initialization trick which will make sure we don't fall into the random initialization trap.
cues.zh: 基本上是一種進階初始化技巧，確保我們不會落入隨機初始化陷阱。

cues.en: So, we must absolutely input that parameter, and the name of that parameter is "init", and the value to select, well that "K-means++" initialization is called
cues.zh: 所以一定要輸入這個參數；名稱是 init，要選擇 K-means++ 初始化，設定值叫做

cues.en: in quotes because that's a string.
cues.zh: 要加引號，因為它是字串。

cues.en: "K-means++", just like that.
cues.zh: "k-means++"，像這樣。

cues.en: All right, so now we're safe from the random initialization trap.
cues.zh: 好，現在就能避開隨機初始化陷阱了。

cues.en: And now we will just add one final argument.
cues.zh: 接著再加上最後一個引數。

cues.en: You know this one very well.
cues.zh: 這個你很熟悉。

cues.en: It's just in order for us to have the exact same results on our notebook so that we can, you know follow and describe what's happening on our notebook.
cues.zh: 只是為了讓我們的筆記本得到完全相同的結果，方便一起操作並說明筆記本中的情況。

cues.en: And that parameter is of course "random_state", which we will set equal to 42.
cues.zh: 這個參數當然是 random_state，我們把它設為 42。

cues.en: 42 apparently is a number that brings luck in mathematics.
cues.zh: 據說 42 在數學裡是會帶來好運的數字。

cues.en: I'm not saying that I believe in this, but anyway we just have to fix the seed here.
cues.zh: 我不是說自己相信這件事，總之這裡只要固定種子值。

cues.en: And any number is okay as long as we choose the same.
cues.zh: 任何數字都可以，只要我們選一樣的就好。

cues.en: All right, so 42.
cues.zh: 好，設為 42。

cues.en: And now the next step, because we only created the object so far.
cues.zh: 接著進行下一步，因為目前只建立了物件。

cues.en: We haven't run the algorithm yet.
cues.zh: 還沒有執行演算法。

cues.en: Well, here we go.
cues.zh: 來吧。

cues.en: That's the next step.
cues.zh: 這就是下一步。

cues.en: The next step is to run the algorithm.
cues.zh: 下一步是執行演算法。

cues.en: And by running the algorithm, I actually mean train it.
cues.zh: 所謂執行演算法，其實就是訓練它。

cues.en: You know, we, we are ready to train the K-means algorithm with that "i" number of clusters, and as any function you know, especially in the "Scikit Learn" library.
cues.zh: 我們已經準備好用 i 個群組訓練 K-means 演算法；和其他函式一樣，尤其是在 scikit-learn 函式庫中，

cues.en: But also, you know, in the "TensorFlow" library while the function used to train an algorithm, a machinery model, is the fit function here a method?
cues.zh: 也包括 TensorFlow，訓練演算法或機器學習模型所用的函式就是 fit；這裡是方法，

cues.en: Because it'll be called from this K-means object.
cues.zh: 因為會從這個 KMeans 物件來呼叫。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: The next step here is of course to take, well our K-means object from which we're gonna call that fit method, which will take as input.
cues.zh: 下一步當然是取出 KMeans 物件，呼叫它的 fit 方法，而這個方法的輸入是什麼？

cues.en: Well, you're gonna tell me what does it take as input?
cues.zh: 你來告訴我，它接受什麼輸入？

cues.en: It takes as input this time of course, only the matrix of features X.
cues.zh: 這次的輸入當然只有特徵矩陣 X。

cues.en: Because remember, you know, in the graph that was shown to you to explain the intuition lectures.
cues.zh: 記得概念課裡用來說明的那張圖嗎？

cues.en: Well, in order to train the K-means algorithm we only need the data of the features.
cues.zh: 要訓練 K-means 演算法，只需要特徵資料。

cues.en: And here as a reminder, we are training the K-means algorithm with only the annual income and the spending score.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，這裡只用年收入與消費分數來訓練 K-means 演算法。

cues.en: And you will see that it'll be way enough to identify some patterns.
cues.zh: 你會看到，這樣就綽綽有餘，足以辨識一些模式。

cues.en: You know, some clusters.
cues.zh: 也就是一些群組。

cues.en: All right, and that's it.
cues.zh: 好，就是這樣。

cues.en: That's only what we have to input to run or train the K-means algorithm.
cues.zh: 執行或訓練 K-means 演算法，只需要輸入這些。

cues.en: And so now, according to you.
cues.zh: 你覺得現在呢？

cues.en: Are we done with the iteration of the loop?
cues.zh: 這次迴圈迭代完成了嗎？

cues.en: Well, no, because remember we are only doing this to get one particular thing which we already initialized.
cues.zh: 還沒有，記得我們做這些只是為了取得一個特定的值，而且已經為它做了初始化。

cues.en: I'm talking of course about the W CSS value, which is the within cluster sum of squares between the observation points
cues.zh: 當然就是 WCSS，也就是群內平方和，計算各群組中的觀測點

cues.en: in each cluster and the century of each cluster.
cues.zh: 與該群組質心之間的距離平方總和。

cues.en: So, there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's exactly what we have to compute right now.
cues.zh: 這正是現在要計算的東西。

cues.en: Now that we already trained, and run are K-means algorithm.
cues.zh: 因為我們已經訓練並執行了 K-means 演算法。

cues.en: And well, the way to get that W CSS value is to first take our W CSS list which is so far initialized as an empty list.
cues.zh: 要取得 WCSS 值，先取出目前初始化為空串列的 wcss 串列。

cues.en: And then we're gonna use the append function which is a pre-built function of Python list.
cues.zh: 接著使用 append 函式，它是 Python 串列的內建函式。

cues.en: And which will of course add or append, you know, a new value inside this list.
cues.zh: 當然會把一個新值加入，也就是附加到這個串列中。

cues.en: And the first value it'll depend of course is the W CSS value computed for one cluster.
cues.zh: 第一個加入的值，當然是只有一個群組時計算出的 WCSS。

cues.en: You know, which is therefore actually the sum of the square distances between all the observation points, you know, because there is only one cluster.
cues.zh: 也就是所有觀測點的距離平方總和，因為目前只有一個群組，

cues.en: And the centroid of the single cluster.
cues.zh: 距離都是到這唯一群組的質心。

cues.en: Alright, so append, since it is a function I'm adding some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 好，append 是函式，所以加上一對括號。

cues.en: And well the way to get that W CSS value, is to call an attribute of the K-means object.
cues.zh: 而取得 WCSS 值的方法，是呼叫 KMeans 物件的一個屬性。

cues.en: You know, objects and classes have attributes which can give you directly some values you want.
cues.zh: 物件和類別有屬性，可以直接提供你想要的某些值。

cues.en: And well, luckily for us, there is an attribute of the K-means class.
cues.zh: 幸好 KMeans 類別有一個屬性，

cues.en: Which is called inertia in which will give us exactly that W CSS value.
cues.zh: 叫做 inertia_，正好會提供 WCSS 值。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So, in order to get that attribute we just need to call our object first, because you know, when you want to get an attribute you always have to call it from the object.
cues.zh: 要取得這個屬性，先寫出物件，因為要存取屬性時，一定要透過物件。

cues.en: And then you add a dot and there you go.
cues.zh: 接著加上一個點，就可以了。

cues.en: You call for the attribute in which is here inertia with an underscore at the end.
cues.zh: 存取這個屬性，也就是結尾有底線的 inertia_。

cues.en: All right, congratulations!
cues.zh: 好，恭喜！

cues.en: I think this was the very first "for" loop, we actually built in its course.
cues.zh: 我想這是這門課實際建立的第一個 for 迴圈。

cues.en: So, if it is your very first "for" loop of all time, Congratulations!
cues.zh: 如果這也是你人生中的第一個 for 迴圈，恭喜！

cues.en: As you see this is not nasty at all.
cues.zh: 如你所見，一點都不難。

cues.en: And you actually built a very useful "for" loop which will plot very nicely the graph of the elbow method.
cues.zh: 而且你建立了一個很實用的 for 迴圈，可以用來漂亮地畫出手肘法圖表。

cues.en: And now to get out of the "for" loop, we need to, you know, go back here at the beginning of the row to specify to Python that we are indeed not anymore in the loop,
cues.zh: 現在要離開 for 迴圈，就必須回到這裡的行首，告訴 Python 我們已經不在迴圈裡，

cues.en: and that we are back in the main code.
cues.zh: 而是回到主程式碼。

cues.en: And speaking of the main code, well the only thing that we're left to do is just to plot the graph.
cues.zh: 說到主程式碼，現在剩下的事就只有畫圖。
